messages:
claire: Heads-up: noticed a pattern of somescan SAST hits failing the premerge lint with 'proto-generated code exclusion' after the proto schema update. It looks like our scan suppression rules didn't include the new generated path.

omar: can you paste the file path?

claire: path: services/payments/gen/proto/v2/payment.pb.go

omar: yep, scanner is flagging it for 'unsafe-serialization' — FP likely. we've seen this when generated code gets picked up by our regex-based allowlist.

tess: this is a good time to revisit the suppression policy. the old approach relies on path prefixes that break when we version proto outputs. we should switch to a manifest-based allowlist (build artifact metadata) that the scanner can consult.

ryan: agree. manifest would be more robust. downside: we need buildstep to emit that metadata and we need to keep the manifest signed or at least checksummed for audits.

sec-bot: Note: create-suppression-request required for changing the suppress list. Use ticket SCAN-SUPP-9001.

claire: I'll open SCAN-SUPP-9001 with files, rationale, and proof-of-false-positive. Also adding a short-term override to avoid blocking the release.

omar: short-term override should be timeboxed and have an owner. put the owner as the codeowner for the proto package.

tess: for the manifest approach: build emits artifacts/metadata/manifest.json with entries like {"path":..., "type": "generated", "checksum": "..."}. scanner checks manifest on premerge. if mismatch -> fail.

ryan: also add a verification hook in the security runbook to ensure we don't suppress real findings via gen file mistakes. sample: random fuzz test on generated marshal/unmarshal to surface unsafe patterns.

claire: opened ticket SCAN-SUPP-9001 (owner: claire). Temporary override applied until 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z.

omar: I'll update the scanner docs to prefer manifest-based allowlist and include code snippets.

claire: thanks all. follow-up: once manifest patch lands, we'll roll out a small canary to payments service CI to prevent surprises.

ryan: tagging privacy for sign-off on signed manifest requirement.

sec-bot: Ticket created: SCAN-SUPP-9001, severity=low, owner=claire
